name: url-shortener
description: Link management platform: short links, custom domains, QR codes, analytics, A/B testing

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm --recursive run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm --recursive run test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm --filter @url-shortener/api run test:e2e
scripts.test:web:e2e: pnpm run build:contracts && pnpm --filter @url-shortener/web run test:e2e
